title: Eufy Security Event Sync Gap Watch
dataSources: NVR object-detection (`frigate:event`), camera health (`camera:health`), alarm arm/disarm and life-safety (`alarm:event`), lock access (`lock:access`), plate recognition (`plate:detection`), doorbell (`doorbell:event`).
app: Frigate / Blue Iris NVR object-detection events, camera health, alarm and smart-lock logs, and licence-plate recognition via MQTT and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=eufy:security
| stats max(_time) as last_seen by device_name
| eval hours_since=round((now()-last_seen)/3600,1)
| where hours_since>1
| sort - hours_since
description: Detects when Eufy security event data has stopped arriving for a given device.
value: Personal telemetry is only useful when it is current; sync-gap alerts catch failed exports and broken credentials early.
implementation: Track the latest event time per device and alert when the feed is older than 1 hours.
visualization: Table of entities by hours since last event.
grandmaExplanation: It helps keep when one part of your Eufy security event feed has stopped checking in and probably needs fixing.
